paragraphs.text: The Reality Chip is an illegal bio-enhancement artifact from Kamigawa that influences the physics of reality.

It is made of metal, thin and square, and no bigger than the palm of a hand, with wire-like arms reaching out of it like a Jellyfish . It can move under its power, but not to the extent of demonstrating any will. Though typed a Legendary creature, its sapience is unknown, as is most of the specifics of its capabilities. It may be dangerous not just to Kamigawa, but to multiple planes . The Reality Chip seems to augment power that is already there, such as the Wanderer 's spark , but doesn't seem to be enough to empower multiple forms of magic. It also seems to grant some form of prescience or extrasensory perception, and also has a function that disables whatever it's attached to.

The essences of multiple kami were sacrificed in the creation of the Chip. The planeswalker Tezzeret can manipulate the Reality Chip from a short distance. Jin-Gitaxias had ownership of a compleated version, but whether or not it was the corrupted original or a duplicate is unknown.

The Reality Chip was developed by Tezzeret with help from the Saiba Futurists . Tezzeret unsuccessfully attempted to control the kami Kyodai with a prototype Reality Chip. The Chip ignited the Emperor 's planeswalker's spark but left it unstable, causing the irregularities with her planeswalking ability.

The Kamigawan planeswalker Kaito Shizuki found a blueprint of the device in his friend Tameshi 's office. When he found out about its history, he argued that the device could also stabilize the Wanderer's spark. Another native Kamigawan planeswalker, Tamiyo , agreed to help him. Kaito found the Chip in Tameshi's Laboratory but was immediately attacked by the Phyrexian Jin-Gitaxias and Tezzeret's Reckoners . He was saved by Tamiyo and the returned Wanderer.

The Wanderer attached the Reality Chip to her hand and it helped to stabilize her spark for a while. In an instant, the panel flashed with light, and the wires fused to her flesh like veins pulsing with energy. However, it also provided her with grueling visions of Jin-Gitaxias. In an attempt to destroy the machine in Tameshi's laboratory that was connected to the Chip, Tamiyo and Kaito walked into a trap set up by Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias.

However, the Emperor saw this trap being sprung, and so intervened, saving Kaito and Tamiyo. They also captured Tezzeret in the process, knocking him unconscious. To quickly return to Eiganjo Castle , the Emperor gave Tamiyo the Reality Chip to amplify her telekinetic power, so that she could hotwire a nearby flying mech . Tezzeret awoke as they arrived, though, and caused the mech to crash. He then kidnapped Tamiyo and traveled back to New Phyrexia using the Planar Bridge .

Once there, the Reality Chip possibly allowed Jin-Gitaxias to compleat Tamiyo as the first Phyrexian planeswalker, a feat previously thought not possible due to the nature of planeswalker sparks. Jin-Gitaxias also used an updated version of the Reality Chip infused with glistening oil to speed up the process of turning darksteel into blightsteel.
